properties.name: Same doc restructure, second pass: the three new failure modes went into the existing Troubleshooting table rather than only into the step-by-step prose — a table people already scan when something is wrong beats an instruction they read once during setup. Rows added: the server refusing to start because a session still launches its own reflow2, a remote 403 naming the unlisted host, and connect-failure pointed at the network rather than at reflow2.
